> What it is: A small box on your desk that shifts colors (like from green to blue or red) whenever you wave your hand over it, without you ever touching it.  How it works: An ultrasonic sensor sends out a silent sound wave (just like a bat does). If your hand is close, the wave bounces back quickly. The microcontroller reads this and follows a simple rule: "If hand is closer than 10cm, change light color. Otherwise, stay green."
